out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. OBSERVED SPRAY BOTTLE OF UNKNOWN CHEMICAL NEXT TO CONTAINER OF BULK DRAIN CLEANER AT BAR.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. EMPLOYEE LABELLED SPRAY BOTTLE WITH CHEMICAL NAME.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: LETTUCE AT SERVER STATION.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. CFM HAD EMPLOYEE MARK CONTAINERS OF LETTUCE WITH 4 HOUR END POINT- 3:00PM.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: #2 - COLD RAIL NOT WORKING, #5 - COLD RAIL NOT WORKING.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CFM STATED WORK ORDER HAS BEEN PLACED FOR BOTH UNITS. NO FOOD IS KEPT ON #2 COLD RAIL, FOOD ON #5 COLD RAIL IS KEPT ON ICE AND MONITORED.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: CFM COULD NOT LOCATE IRREVERSIBLE REGISTERING THERMOMETER FOR HIGH TEMPERATURE DISH MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. CFM WILL PURCHASE THERMOMETER AND PROVIDE PROOF OF PURCHASE TO EHS.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of SPILLED JUICE RESIDUE: INTERIOR OF BAR REFRIGERATION UNITS.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. CLEAN INTERIOR OF BAR REFRIGERATION UNITS OF JUICE, FRUIT RESIDUES.

violations.observation: OBSERVED WALLS THROUGHOUT KITCHEN IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Ventilation Hood, Adequate
violations.observation: OBSERVED VENTILATION HOOD ABOVE HIGH TEMPERATURE DISH MACHINE UNABLE TO SUFFICIENTLY EXTRACT STEAM EMITTED FROM DISH MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: Ventilation hood systems and devices shall operate properly and be sufficient in number and capacity to prevent grease or condensation from collecting on walls and ceilings. CFM WILL PLACE WORK ORDER TO SERVICE VENTILATION HOOD.

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. No CFM present during inspection. Both PIC are in process of studying and taking CFM exam.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A follow-up inspection will be conducted on or around 10 days to ensure a CFM is present during all hours of operation. P.F. CHANG'S CHINA BISTRO (Inspection Date: 10/02/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at hand sink in dish washing area.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. Employee provided paper towels.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 2 DR UC bar.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Observed fruit flies at bar closest to dish washing area.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. Thoroughly clean bar area and request pest control treat for fruit flies.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. Observed unapproved splitter installed on mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS provided via email approved backflow prevention device options for mop sink. Request approved device be installed within 3 days.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency

violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed hole in wall in dish washing area.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Patch hole in wall.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the sanitizer solution was measured at 0 ppm in the sanitizer bucket next to the cook line. This concentration is below the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of quaternary ammonium solution at 200-400ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. EHS reviewed with CFM which sanitizer solution must be used for food contact surfaces, equipment and utensils. EHS observed that establishment had both Ecolab Multi-quat and Ecolab Sink and Surface sanitizers. Ensure facility has both types of test strips to verify proper concentration is being dispensed. Multi Surface Cleaner and Disinfectant is not to be used for sanitizing food contact surfaces in the kitchen.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 4 DWR REF under cook tops.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. CFM will place thermometer in drawer of unit. P.F. CHANG'S CHINA BISTRO (Inspection Date: 01/27/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: oil squirt bottles throughout kitchen and at cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM will have employees label bottles with oil name.
